title: Die Roll
statementMd:
Yakko, Wakko and Dot, world-famous animaniacs, decided to rest from acting in cartoons, and take a leave to travel a bit. Yakko dreamt to go to Pennsylvania, his Motherland and the Motherland of his ancestors. Wakko thought about Tasmania, its beaches, sun and sea. Dot chose Transylvania as the most mysterious and unpredictable place.

But to their great regret, the leave turned to be very short, so it will be enough to visit one of the three above named places. That's why Yakko, as the cleverest, came up with a truly genius idea: let each of the three roll an ordinary six-sided die, and the one with the highest amount of points will be the winner, and will take the other two to the place of his/her dreams.

Yakko thrown a die and got `Y` points, Wakko — `W` points. It was Dot's turn. But she didn't hurry. Dot wanted to know for sure what were her chances to visit Transylvania.

It is known that Yakko and Wakko are true gentlemen, that's why if they have the same amount of points with Dot, they will let Dot win.

## Input

The only line of the input file contains two natural numbers `Y` and `W` — the results of Yakko's and Wakko's die rolls.

## Output

Output the required probability in the form of irreducible fraction in format «`A/B`», where `A` — the numerator, and `B` — the denominator. If the required probability equals to zero, output «`0/1`». If the required probability equals to 1, output «`1/1`».

## Note

Dot will go to Transylvania, if she is lucky to roll 4, 5 or 6 points.
statementZhMd:
Yakko、Wakko 和 Dot 是世界闻名的卡通角色，他们决定暂时停止出演动画片，休假出去旅行。Yakko 梦想着前往宾夕法尼亚州，那是他的祖国，也是他祖先的故乡。Wakko 则想去塔斯马尼亚，享受那里的沙滩、阳光与大海。Dot 选择了特兰西瓦尼亚，因为那里是最神秘、最不可预测的地方。

但遗憾的是，他们的假期非常短，因此只能在上述三个地方中选择一个游览。于是，三人中最聪明的 Yakko 想出了一个绝妙的主意：让三人各自掷一次普通的六面骰子，点数最高的人获胜，并带着另外两人前往自己梦想中的地方。

Yakko 掷出了骰子，得到 `Y` 点；Wakko 得到了 `W` 点。轮到 Dot 了，但她并不急着掷骰子。Dot 想先确切地知道自己前往特兰西瓦尼亚的概率。

已知 Yakko 和 Wakko 都是真正的绅士，因此如果他们的点数与 Dot 相同，他们会让 Dot 获胜。

## 输入格式

输入文件仅一行，包含两个自然数 `Y` 和 `W`，分别表示 Yakko 和 Wakko 掷骰子的结果。

## 输出格式

以最简分数的形式输出所求概率，格式为“`A/B`”，其中 `A` 是分子，`B` 是分母。如果所求概率为 0，输出“`0/1`”；如果所求概率为 1，输出“`1/1`”。

## 说明

如果 Dot 幸运地掷出 4、5 或 6 点，她就会前往特兰西瓦尼亚。
